title: Reveal Math, Course 2
edition: 2018/2020 national edition (Interactive Student Edition and Teacher Edition, 2 volumes each)

summary: McGraw Hill's grade 7 course in the Reveal Math middle-school series, in 11 modules and about 62 lessons. It covers proportional relationships and percent applications; integer and rational-number operations; linear expressions, two-step equations, and inequalities; angles, scale drawings, circles, area, surface area, and volume; probability; and sampling.

toc.label: Module 1
toc.title: Proportional Relationships
toc.covers: Unit rates with fractions and recognizing and representing proportional relationships in tables, graphs, and equations.

children.title: Unit Rates Involving Ratios of Fractions
children.covers: Computing unit rates when both quantities are fractions.

children.title: Understand Proportional Relationships
children.covers: Deciding whether two quantities are proportional by checking for equivalent ratios.

children.title: Tables of Proportional Relationships
children.covers: Testing tables for a constant ratio and finding the constant of proportionality.

children.title: Graphs of Proportional Relationships
children.covers: Recognizing proportional graphs as lines through the origin and interpreting the point (1, r).

children.title: Equations of Proportional Relationships
children.covers: Writing and using equations of the form y = kx.

children.title: Solve Problems Involving Proportional Relationships
children.covers: Solving multi-step ratio and proportion problems in context.

toc.label: Module 2
toc.title: Solve Percent Problems
toc.covers: Percent change and everyday percent applications from tax to percent error.

children.title: Percent of Change
children.covers: Finding percent increase and decrease.

children.title: Tax
children.covers: Computing sales tax and total cost.

children.title: Tips and Markups
children.covers: Computing tips and retail markups.

children.title: Discounts
children.covers: Finding sale prices and percent discounts.

children.title: Interest
children.covers: Computing simple interest with I = prt.

children.title: Commission and Fees
children.covers: Computing commissions and percent-based fees.

children.title: Percent Error
children.covers: Comparing an estimate to an actual value as a percent error.

toc.label: Module 3
toc.title: Operations with Integers
toc.covers: Adding, subtracting, multiplying, and dividing integers and applying them in multi-step problems.

children.title: Add Integers
children.covers: Adding integers with number lines, counters, and sign rules.

children.title: Subtract Integers
children.covers: Subtracting integers by adding the additive inverse.

children.title: Multiply Integers
children.covers: Multiplying integers and the sign rules for products.

children.title: Divide Integers
children.covers: Dividing integers and the sign rules for quotients.

children.title: Apply Integer Operations
children.covers: Evaluating expressions and solving problems that combine integer operations.

toc.label: Module 4
toc.title: Operations with Rational Numbers
toc.covers: How operations with rational numbers extend the rules for integers, including converting fractions to decimals.

children.title: Rational Numbers
children.covers: Identifying terminating and repeating decimals and converting rational numbers to decimals by long division.

children.title: Add Rational Numbers
children.covers: Adding rational numbers, including using additive inverses.

children.title: Subtract Rational Numbers
children.covers: Subtracting rational numbers as adding the additive inverse, in real-world problems.

children.title: Multiply Rational Numbers
children.covers: Multiplying rational numbers and using the order of operations in real-world problems.

children.title: Divide Rational Numbers
children.covers: Dividing rational numbers and using the order of operations in real-world problems.

children.title: Apply Rational Number Operations
children.covers: Evaluating expressions that combine all four operations with rational numbers.

toc.label: Module 5
toc.title: Simplify Algebraic Expressions
toc.covers: Simplifying, adding, subtracting, and factoring linear expressions with rational coefficients.

children.title: Simplify Algebraic Expressions
children.covers: Combining like terms and using properties to simplify expressions.

children.title: Add Linear Expressions
children.covers: Adding linear expressions by combining like terms.

children.title: Subtract Linear Expressions
children.covers: Subtracting linear expressions by adding the opposite.

children.title: Factor Linear Expressions
children.covers: Factoring linear expressions using the GCF and the Distributive Property.

children.title: Combine Operations with Linear Expressions
children.covers: Simplifying expressions that mix distributing, adding, and subtracting.

toc.label: Module 6
toc.title: Write and Solve Equations
toc.covers: One-step and two-step equations of the forms px + q = r and p(x + q) = r, written from context and solved.

children.title: Write and Solve One-Step Equations
children.covers: Writing and solving one-step equations with rational numbers.

children.title: Solve Two-Step Equations: px + q = r
children.covers: Solving px + q = r equations with bar diagrams and inverse operations.

children.title: Write and Solve Two-Step Equations: px + q = r
children.covers: Writing px + q = r equations from word problems and solving them.

children.title: Solve Two-Step Equations: p(x + q) = r
children.covers: Solving equations with parentheses of the form p(x + q) = r.

children.title: Write and Solve Two-Step Equations: p(x + q) = r
children.covers: Writing p(x + q) = r equations from context and solving them.

toc.label: Module 7
toc.title: Write and Solve Inequalities
toc.covers: One-step and two-step inequalities, including the sign flip for negative coefficients, written from context and graphed.

children.title: Solve One-Step Addition and Subtraction Inequalities
children.covers: Solving and graphing x + p > q type inequalities.

children.title: Write and Solve One-Step Addition and Subtraction Inequalities
children.covers: Writing addition and subtraction inequalities from word problems and solving them.

children.title: Solve One-Step Multiplication and Division Inequalities with Positive Coefficients
children.covers: Solving px > q type inequalities when p is positive.

children.title: Solve One-Step Multiplication and Division Inequalities with Negative Coefficients
children.covers: Reversing the inequality symbol when multiplying or dividing by a negative.

children.title: Write and Solve One-Step Multiplication and Division Inequalities
children.covers: Writing multiplication and division inequalities from context and interpreting solutions.

children.title: Write and Solve Two-Step Inequalities
children.covers: Writing and solving px + q > r inequalities and graphing the solution set.

toc.label: Module 8
toc.title: Geometric Figures
toc.covers: Angle relationships, constructing triangles, scale drawings, and three-dimensional figures and their cross sections.

children.title: Vertical and Adjacent Angles
children.covers: Using vertical and adjacent angle relationships to find unknown angles.

children.title: Complementary and Supplementary Angles
children.covers: Writing and solving equations from complementary and supplementary angle facts.

children.title: Triangles
children.covers: Classifying triangles and deciding when given sides or angles form a unique triangle.

children.title: Scale Drawings
children.covers: Using a scale to find actual lengths and areas and to redraw at a different scale.

children.title: Three-Dimensional Figures
children.covers: Identifying prisms and pyramids and describing cross sections made by slicing them.

toc.label: Module 9
toc.title: Measure Figures
toc.covers: Circumference and area of circles, composite areas, and volume and surface area of prisms, pyramids, and composite solids.

children.title: Circumference of Circles
children.covers: Finding circumference from radius or diameter.

children.title: Area of Circles
children.covers: Finding the area of circles and semicircles.

children.title: Area of Composite Figures
children.covers: Finding areas of figures made of polygons and circle parts.

children.title: Volume
children.covers: Finding the volume of prisms and pyramids.

children.title: Surface Area
children.covers: Finding the surface area of prisms and pyramids.

children.title: Volume and Surface Area of Composite Figures
children.covers: Finding volume and surface area of solids built from simpler solids.

toc.label: Module 10
toc.title: Probability
toc.covers: Likelihood, experimental and theoretical probability, compound events, and simulations.

children.title: Find Likelihoods
children.covers: Describing how likely an event is on a scale from 0 to 1.

children.title: Relative Frequency of Simple Events
children.covers: Finding experimental probability from the results of trials.

children.title: Theoretical Probability of Simple Events
children.covers: Finding theoretical probability and predicting outcomes.

children.title: Compare Probabilities of Simple Events
children.covers: Comparing experimental and theoretical probabilities and explaining differences.

children.title: Probability of Compound Events
children.covers: Finding compound-event probabilities with organized lists, tables, and tree diagrams.

children.title: Simulate Chance Events
children.covers: Designing and running simulations to estimate probabilities.

toc.label: Module 11
toc.title: Sampling and Statistics
toc.covers: Random sampling, predictions from samples, sampling variability, and comparing two populations.

children.title: Biased and Unbiased Samples
children.covers: Distinguishing biased from unbiased samples and why random sampling matters.

children.title: Make Predictions
children.covers: Using sample data to make predictions about a population.

children.title: Generate Multiple Samples
children.covers: Drawing repeated random samples to gauge how much estimates vary.

children.title: Compare Two Populations
children.covers: Comparing two populations with measures of center and variability.

children.title: Assess Visual Overlap
children.covers: Expressing the difference between two centers as a multiple of their variability.

notes: Volume 1 holds Modules 1-4; Volume 2 holds Modules 5-11 (the English Tennessee student-edition cover and the Spanish national student-edition cover in the 2020 catalog agree). The work-list ISBNs match the 2020 catalog: Interactive Student Edition Vol. 1 978-0-07-667374-2, Vol. 2 978-0-07-899715-0; Teacher Edition Vol. 1 978-0-07-899723-5, Vol. 2 978-0-07-899176-9. Module titles come from the publisher; lesson sequence comes from a district pacing guide that abbreviates titles, so full lesson titles were taken from the publisher's Oklahoma overview and the New Mexico sampler where they agree. Lessons 3-1, 3-2, 4-5, and 10-5 appear only in the district guide and the sampler, because the Oklahoma edition moves or drops them; treat the exact wording of 3-1, 3-2, and 10-5 as unconfirmed. Lesson 9-4 covers prisms and pyramids per the district guide. Most lesson descriptions are from general knowledge of the topic.
